Type-in answers take a number only: no %, ₹ or units. Use a decimal, not a fraction.

groups.title: Tea stall sales
groups.text:
A tea company runs four stalls in Pune. The figures show how many cups each stall sold in each month from July to October, in hundreds of cups. For example, 42 means 4,200 cups.

Stall: July, August, September, October

Aundh: 42, 45, 50, 48

Baner: 38, 44, 41, 47

Kothrud: 55, 52, 58, 72

Wakad: 30, 36, 40, 45

questions.text: Which stall had the largest percentage increase in sales from July to October?
By how many hundred cups did the four stalls' combined sales in October exceed their combined sales in July?
In how many stalls did sales go up every month, compared with the month before?
A cup cost ₹12 in July and August and ₹15 in September and October, at every stall. What were the Kothrud stall's total takings over the four months, in ₹ thousand?
